feature_freeze.policy: After the freeze commit, no new features are merged; only defect fixes, security patches, and release tooling changes.

defect_zero.policy: A Release Candidate ships only when there are zero blocker and zero critical defects.

same_commit.policy: Every RC artifact (client, gateway, sync, wasm, CLI) must be built from the exact same source commit; the artifact provenance records it (T169).
